svg.title: Incoming monitored-call analysis and response
svg.desc: Event Grid starts the incoming-call path. PolicyGate and Actuator govern remediation, not the language model. Source-verified EntraGuard flow. Official Microsoft architecture icons.

text.tspan: Event Grid starts the incoming-call path. PolicyGate and Actuator govern remediation, not the language model.
NUMBERED INTERACTIONS · time runs downward · dashed = response / conditional interaction (not every branch runs)
Numbers match the interaction on the left.
01 A call reaches the configured monitored ACS identity; this is
not interception of arbitrary tenant phone calls.
02 Validate the separate Event Grid secret; handle subscription
validation and deduplicate recent correlation IDs.
03 Create an in-memory call and map participant roles. Answer
quickly without waiting for Graph or model inference.
04 Use path-bound signed callbacks/WSS. AI Speech transcribes per
participant channel while audio receipt continues.
05 A three-second timer requests analysis over 45 seconds of
text. Actual inference latency determines cadence.
06 Return risk, confidence, stage and evidence. Analyst failure
retains the previous assessment, not a fabricated safe score.
07 Effective risk adds urgency: 0 / 5 / 15 / 10 for Unaware /
and already-executed checks. Preserve withheld reasons.
09 Telemetry is per assessment. At effective risk 40, notify SOC
10 At 60, synthesize a warning with AI Speech and send PCM
through the ACS media socket if permitted.
11 At 80, allowed tools can create an incident and revoke
sessions; P2 risk elevation or degraded-tier quarantine is
12 At 90, termination also needs AboutToApprove and confidence
≥0.75. Tools run in defined escalation order.
publish live updates. Unavailable tools do not stop later tools.
Verification and enrollment calls set IsVerificationCall and skip Actuator execution in the live loop. Their own verification decisions remain separate.
Graph containment writes use the home credential; identity actions also require a resolved subject. Cross-tenant Graph reads do not imply cross-tenant containment.
Source/configuration review · 20 September 2026 · not a live deployment audit · original Microsoft icons; see asset credits and source references in the companion guide.
